parent.name: Skirts
parent.headline:
A little movement.
A new direction.
parent.description:
The everyday mini. The flowing midi.
Find the shape that feels like you.
parent.style: Let your skirt set the mood.
parent.advice: Start with a shape you love, then change the feeling with a simple top. A crisp shirt brings definition; a relaxed knit makes the same skirt feel easy. There is more than one way to wear your favourite.
parent.detailLine: A pleat. A hem. A different feeling.
parent.heroAlt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in a terracotta pleated midi skirt and ivory top in a pale stone courtyard
parent.browseTitle: Find your shape. Make it yours.
parent.campaignNote: The collection header images are illustrative campaign styling inspiration.

collections.name: Casual Skirts
collections.headline:
Easy days.
Your own way.
collections.description: From a favourite tee to a fresh white shirt, find a skirt for the everyday.
collections.advice: Let a print set the mood, then add a plain top and comfortable flats. A light cardigan makes the same outfit work when the day cools.

collections.name: Corduroy Skirts
collections.headline:
A little texture.
A fresh start.
collections.description: Explore corduroy skirts with a tactile finish and plenty of everyday character.
collections.advice: Pair corduroy with a smooth cotton shirt or a simple knit. Add tights and ankle boots for a layered look, checking each listing for fabric details.

collections.name: Denim Skirts
collections.headline:
Familiar denim.
A new shape.
collections.description: Mini, midi or long: discover another way to wear your favourite blue.
collections.advice: Try a tucked-in tee with a longer denim skirt, or balance a short hem with an easy shirt. Choose the length and shape that suit your day.

collections.name: Gypsy Skirts
collections.headline:
Room to move.
Made for you.
collections.description: Explore flowing shapes, expressive prints and relaxed bohemian styling.
collections.advice: Keep your top simple when a print does the talking. A fitted vest balances a fuller hem, while flat sandals keep the outfit relaxed.

collections.name: High Waisted Skirts
collections.headline:
A higher waist.
A fresh line.
collections.description: Discover waist-defining shapes, from everyday denim to statement prints.
collections.advice: Tuck in a lightweight shirt or try a shorter knit to show the waistband. Use the individual waist measurements to choose a comfortable fit.

collections.name: Knee Length Skirts
collections.assignment: Editorial selection based on source photographs and product names; fit and length vary by garment.
collections.headline:
The middle ground.
All your own.
collections.description: An edit of knee-skimming and nearby midi lengths, chosen for easy outfit building.
collections.advice: Try a clean-lined shirt with a pencil shape, or a neat tee with a pleated skirt. Where a hem falls depends on your height, so compare the listed length with a skirt you own.

collections.name: Leather Skirts
collections.headline:
A sharper edge.
A softer touch.
collections.description: Explore leather-look finishes and defined silhouettes for a different kind of everyday.
collections.advice: A textured knit or simple cotton shirt softens a sleek skirt. Check each product listing for the exact material, stretch and care instructions.

collections.name: Long Skirts
collections.headline:
Longer lines.
Easy movement.
collections.description: Discover flowing lengths, expressive prints and skirts that make an outfit.
collections.advice: A shorter top gives a long skirt room to shine. Try flat sandals for a relaxed finish, or a neat jacket when you want a little more structure.

collections.name: Pleated Skirts
collections.headline:
A little movement.
A lot of feeling.
collections.description: Discover the rhythm of pleats, from playful short shapes to flowing midi styles.
collections.advice: Keep the top half simple and let the pleats bring the detail. A fine knit or tucked-in tee makes an easy starting point.

collections.name: Short Skirts
collections.headline:
A shorter hem.
A fresh mood.
collections.description: Mini lengths and expressive details, ready to style your way.
collections.advice: Try a roomy shirt with a short skirt, or pair a neat knit with tights and boots. Check the garment length to find your preferred coverage.

collections.name: Slit Skirts
collections.headline:
A small detail.
A bold line.
collections.description: Explore skirts with split details, from printed everyday styles to a sleek evening look.
collections.advice: A plain top keeps the focus on the split. Check the opening and overall length in the product photographs before choosing your fit.

collections.name: Suede Skirts
collections.headline:
Soft-looking texture.
Clean lines.
collections.description: Discover suede-look finishes in mini and pencil silhouettes.
collections.advice: Pair a suede-look skirt with a crisp shirt or a ribbed knit. Check the product composition and care label before cleaning.

collections.name: Summer & Beach Skirts
collections.headline:
Sunlit days.
Easy layers.
collections.description: Prints, flowing hems and relaxed shapes for your warm-weather wardrobe.
collections.advice: Start with a simple vest and flat sandals, then add a loose shirt. Check the listing for fabric weight, lining and coverage.

collections.name: Work & Business Skirts
collections.headline:
A considered shape.
Your daily rhythm.
collections.description: Build a workday outfit around a pencil silhouette, a print or a flowing hem.
collections.advice: Try a tucked-in blouse with a neat jacket, then choose shoes for the day ahead. Check the hem length and fabric for your own workplace.

collections.name: Wrap Skirts
collections.headline:
A different angle.
A personal touch.
collections.description: Discover wrap-inspired shapes, asymmetric lines and expressive prints.
collections.advice: A simple fitted top lets an overlapping hem stand out. Check whether each design has a working tie or a fixed wrap effect.

collections.name: A-Line Skirts
collections.headline:
A gentle flare.
A fresh perspective.
collections.description: Discover skirts that open out from the waist, in prints and everyday finishes.
collections.advice: Try a tucked-in tee or a shorter knit with an A-line shape. Keep the waistband visible if you want to emphasise the flare.
